big: India has five listed REITs. Together they paid out more than ₹8,900 crore to over 4.25 lakh unitholders in FY2026. Their buildings cover more than 187 million sq ft. Yet they are not alike.

lines: That is not what this lesson is for. Learn what each holds. Most hold office and business parks. One holds retail malls. Each differs in tenants, cities, leases and debt. Read the latest investor presentation, not just the yield.

intro: As per the lesson text. Check current SEBI rules and REIT disclosures.
note: Combined: ₹8,900 crore+ distributed in FY2026 (Indian REITs Association data, as reported in May 2026). Gross asset value over ₹2.72 lakh crore in March 2026.
